entities.summary: Philip of Cleves was a son of John I, duke of Cleves, and Elizabeth of Nevers. After several minor ecclesiastical posts, Philip was bishop of Nevers from 1500 until his death. He was also bishop of Amiens from 1501 to 1503. In 1505, he was bishop of Autun for a short time.
